title: The Wanderlane Traveller Club Card: Its States and the Two Balances It Carries
content:
A Wanderlane Traveller Club card stands at one of five states — applied, active, suspended, lapsed or closed — and carries two balances.

## The two balances

The spendable balance holds the club points the member may spend. Accruals, bonuses and arriving transfers credit it, and redemptions, transfers out and expiry sweeps debit it.

The qualifying balance holds the tier-qualifying points counted in the current qualifying period. Qualifying accruals credit it and the end-of-period clear-down debits it.

## The register of movements

| Movement | Effected by | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| An application is confirmed | The programme's own systems | The enrolment is confirmed and the card becomes usable |
| An active card is put on hold | The desk | The card is put on hold while an abuse or fraud question is examined |
| The hold on a card is lifted | The desk | The question is settled and the hold on the card is lifted |
| An active card falls dormant | The programme's own systems | No activity at all was recorded for the inactivity term and the card falls dormant |
| A dormant card is brought back to life | The desk | A dormant card is brought back to life at the member's request |
| The member closes their own card | The member | The member closes their own card and gives up its balance |
| A dormant card is retired for good | The programme's own systems | A dormant card is retired for good |
| A card on hold is withdrawn | The desk | The abuse question is decided against the member and the card is withdrawn |

## The standing rules

An enrolment becomes usable once the application is confirmed, and a card that is never confirmed carries no benefit and earns nothing.

A card is suspended where the programme office is examining an abuse or fraud question, and while it is suspended the member may earn but may not spend.

A suspended card is reinstated once the question is settled, with the tier and both balances exactly as they stood at suspension.

A membership with no activity at all for the inactivity term of the tier held falls dormant, and falling dormant sweeps the spendable balance.

Only the member may close their own card, and closure forfeits every point on it with no payment of any kind; the agency records the request and the member confirms it.

A closed card is never reopened: a traveller who wishes to rejoin is enrolled afresh at the entry tier with nothing carried over.

## Points of judgement

A card brought back from a hold returns to exactly where it stood: the same tier, the same spendable balance and the same qualifying count. A card enrolled afresh after closure carries none of these over.
